capabilities: Build an interactive timeline of life events and milestones
Resurface memories from the same date in past years
Remind users of anniversaries and milestones
Navigate historical entries for personal reflection
extras: README mentions a Screenshots section but no images are included in the provided text.
motivation: The README frames the goal as transforming how users revisit and cherish their past, turning every day into an opportunity to celebrate the journey of life.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to revisit notes from past dates or view life events on an interactive timeline.
summary: Interactive timeline plugin that collects life milestones from notes and resurfaces past memories with anniversary reminders.
